pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Warm-season:$() sow after the last frost, into warm soil. Sprouts after 70 °C·d above 10 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1700 °C·d$(). Best near 30 °C; stops above 40 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -0.5 °C (0 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 5.8-6.8 (tolerates 5-7.5). Roots 0.8 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 160, P 15, K 60 kg/ha per crop; fixes about 65% of its own nitrogen.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 3123 lb/ac (3.5 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Peanuts.
